content:
Camila Reyes: Launch day war-room thread. Please keep updates in here (go/no-go, site status, traffic, press/analyst, field/support). We’re aiming for publish at 10:00 PT.

Ben Carter: :rotating_light: T-60. Final checklist:
- Landing page live + PDF download working
- Blog post live
- Public table build pushed
- UTM + HubSpot tracking verified
- Press/analyst emails queued
- Field enablement doc pinned
Reply with status + any blockers.

Elliot Price: Web status: landing page PR is merged, deploy scheduled for 09:35 PT. I’ll confirm once CDN is warm. Download route is `/reports/latency-per-dollar-2025.pdf`.

Tyler Benson: Tracking: UTMs reviewed. HubSpot list + lifecycle enrollment ready. GA4 events for `report_download` and `cta_book_consult` firing in staging yesterday; will spot-check prod right after publish.

Ethan Wallace: Blog post final copy is ready; last pass for link integrity in progress. Methodology appendix link points to `/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar#methodology`.

Soojin Lee: Messaging reminder: stick to “production economics” + “latency per dollar” framing. No “fastest” / “best overall” claims. Use “in our measurements” + “see methodology” language.

Jonas Weber: Perf/Evals: sign-off done on results table + variance notes. Claire is on standby if we see anyone misreading p95 vs mean.

Claire Dubois: Confirmed: public table excludes any internal run IDs, instance metadata, or per-request logs. Only aggregated per model/region/workload metrics.

Sean Gallagher: SRE: dashboards are up for the benchmark pages + download endpoint. Alerting on 5xx and p95 latency for the docs site, plus origin error rate. I’m on point until EOD.

Dev Patel: Support: macros are staged (methodology/variance + “how do I reproduce”). Tier-3 on call is Owen. Please @support if we see inbound confusion we need to preempt.

Jordan Blake: Sales: enablement deck + one-pager pinned in #sales. AEs reminded to forward press/analyst inquiries to Marketing, and not to freestyle comparisons.

Ben Carter: Press/analyst: embargo lifts at 10:00 PT. PR Bot will send outreach emails. Camila/Ethan are on for any rapid quote requests.

PR Bot: Scheduled send: press list (18) + analysts (9) at 10:02 PT. Reply STOP to cancel.

Tessa Morgan: Design: final charts + hero image already on S3. Checked accessibility contrast for the key chart colors.

Alicia Perez: Figma export set is final. If we need a hot swap on a chart label (units), I can push updated assets quickly.

Ben Carter: Quick callout: if anything is broken, we either (1) pause email/social, (2) hotfix + resume. Don’t try to “work around” in public.

Elliot Price: Deploy started.

Sean Gallagher: Seeing elevated CDN cache misses (expected on deploy). No errors so far.

Tyler Benson: As soon as live, please everyone use ONLY the UTM’d main link for sharing externally. Internal Slack shares don’t matter, but LinkedIn/X should use:
- `https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks/latency-per-dollar?utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=latency_per_dollar_2025`

Soojin Lee: Also reminder: don’t share the internal raw table link. Only the public landing page + PDF.

Ethan Wallace: Blog post link check: one broken anchor found (`#variance` was `#variability`). Fixing now.

Elliot Price: Landing page is up in prod. I’m seeing the hero + CTAs. PDF download works from my laptop.

Sean Gallagher: Confirmed: docs site 200s. p95 for the landing route currently 310ms. Download endpoint ok.

Tyler Benson: GA4 events firing in prod for `report_download`. HubSpot form submission tested OK. :thumbsup:

Ben Carter: Great. Holding for Ethan’s blog fix, then go/no-go.

Ethan Wallace: Blog fix merged, deploy queued. ETA 6–8 mins.

Camila Reyes: While we wait: escalation paths
- Web/docs issue: @Elliot @Sean
- Data/methodology question: @Jonas @Claire
- Press quote requests: me + @Ethan
- Sales asks: @Jordan
- Support inbound spikes: @Dev

Noura El-Khoury: Community: once live, I’ll post in our community Slack + schedule the newsletter teaser (not full send) for tomorrow.

Stephanie Nguyen: NA field: SDRs are ready w/ the talk track and the “book consult” link. We’re getting a few pings already asking “what’s latency/$?”

Markus Klein: SE note: if prospects ask to reproduce, point them to the minimal example repo + the methodology section. Don’t share internal benchmark-lab configs.

Lukas Meyer: EMEA: Please be careful on “region comparisons” language. EU prospects will ask about data residency; we should proactively say results are reported per region and workloads can differ.

Soojin Lee: +1. Approved line: “We report by region; you should validate on the region you plan to deploy in.”

Ben Carter: Blog deploy status?

Elliot Price: Blog is live now. Verified the variance anchor works.

Camila Reyes: Go/no-go check. Any blockers to publish + begin distribution at 10:00 PT?

Sean Gallagher: No blockers. Site stable.

Tyler Benson: No blockers. Tracking good.

Jonas Weber: No blockers from Perf/Evals.

Dev Patel: Support ready.

Jordan Blake: Field ready.

Camila Reyes: GO. Ben, proceed with schedule.

Ben Carter: Publishing now:
- Landing page already live
- Blog post live
- Social posts begin at 10:05 PT (staggered)
- Press/analyst emails at 10:02 PT

PR Bot: Embargo lifted. Sending outreach now.

Tyler Benson: Watching real-time. First 200 sessions in first minute. Download clicks starting.

Sean Gallagher: Heads up: traffic jump, but still healthy. Origin CPU ok.

Elliot Price: I’m seeing one 404 in logs for `/reports/latency-per-dollar.pdf` (missing “-2025”). Might be someone typing. Do we need a redirect?

Ben Carter: Good catch. We used “-2025” in all assets, but people may guess. Elliot can you add redirect `/reports/latency-per-dollar.pdf` -> `/reports/latency-per-dollar-2025.pdf`?

Elliot Price: Yep, adding now.

Soojin Lee: Please don’t change filenames on the canonical PDF though (it’s already in email). Redirect is fine.

Sean Gallagher: Alert: 5xx spike on download endpoint for ~20s. Investigating.

Elliot Price: That’s probably the redirect deploy. It briefly invalidated cache + hit origin. Should settle.

Sean Gallagher: 5xx back to baseline. p95 download time elevated but improving.

Tyler Benson: Seeing downloads continuing. No drop-off.

Dev Patel: Support inbox: 3 new tickets already, all “can you share raw data / logs?” Using macro: “We publish aggregated tables, no per-request logs.”

Claire Dubois: If they press for raw, we can offer to walk through methodology + help them run the reproduction example against their own workload.

Ben Carter: Social post #1 is out (company account). Please engage, but don’t answer methodology debates in-thread—route to FAQ link.

Camila Reyes: Press: first reply from an outlet asking “are you claiming best-in-class?” I’m responding with approved language + offering a briefing.

Ethan Wallace: If anyone asks for a one-liner: “We benchmark production economics—latency per dollar—across models and regions with a reproducible methodology.”

Jordan Blake: AE ping: prospect asking why their observed latency in Frankfurt differs from report. I’m telling them: validate region + workload, check routing headers, and see the FAQ on variance.

Markus Klein: If they’re on OpenAI-compat endpoint, make sure they set `x-redwood-region` explicitly. We saw people default to “auto” and get routed.

Sean Gallagher: Traffic update (30 min): landing page stable, p95 420ms, error rate <0.2%. PDF downloads at 1.6k.

Tyler Benson: Attribution: top sources are LinkedIn + direct + partner referral. UTM integrity looks clean.

Noura El-Khoury: Community Slack post live. Already 2 threads asking “what about private deployments?” I pointed to Dedicated/Private section + “book consult.”

Dev Patel: Support: getting “Does this include reliability?” questions. Using macro: “This report focuses on latency and cost; reliability is addressed via SLOs and operational tooling; see Console/guardrails section.”

Soojin Lee: Keep answers consistent: “latency/$ is one dimension; we also care about reliability and predictability, but we didn’t roll them into a single score.”

Ben Carter: Analyst request: wants a 15-min follow-up today. Camila/Ethan, can you do 2:30 PT?

Camila Reyes: Yes. Ethan can you join? Jonas optional if we get methodology questions.

Ethan Wallace: I’m in.

Jonas Weber: I’ll join for first 10 mins; if they go deep on variance I can stay.

Elliot Price: Redirect deployed. 404s for guessed PDF path should now resolve.

Sean Gallagher: Confirmed redirect works. Error rate unchanged.

Tyler Benson: Metrics snapshot for EOD doc:
- Sessions: 18.4k
- Downloads: 6.9k
- Book-consult CTA clicks: 312
I’ll post full funnel tomorrow.

Jordan Blake: Field feedback: the “latency/$” concept lands well with eng + procurement, but they want a quick explanation of units. Might be worth adding a small tooltip on the page later.

Alicia Perez: I can draft a tooltip text + icon placement for a quick follow-up PR.

Soojin Lee: Suggest tooltip copy: “Latency per dollar = tokens served per $ (inverted and normalized to time); higher is better. See methodology.” (We should align with the exact phrasing in the appendix.)

Claire Dubois: Careful: we defined it as “tokens per second per dollar” and also show “seconds per $1” in an alternate view internally. For public we used “throughput per dollar” to avoid confusion. Let’s pull exact line from methodology before updating.

Ben Carter: Noted. Post-launch improvement item; not doing today.

Camila Reyes: Any other fires?

Sean Gallagher: None. Stable.

Dev Patel: Support volume manageable. No escalations yet.

Camila Reyes: Great. Keep monitoring for another hour, then we can stand down from war-room mode. If anything changes, update this thread.
